title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 4: the sin offerings for the anointed priest, the whole congregation, a ruler and the common people.

questions.text: What kind of sins does the law of Leviticus 4 deal with?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said: "If anyone sins unintentionally, in any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done..."

answers.text: Sins done on purpose and in defiance

questions.text: What was the anointed priest to offer if he sinned and brought guilt on the people?
questions.explanation: He was to offer for his sin a young bull without defect to Yahweh for a sin offering.

answers.text: A pair of turtledoves without defect

questions.text: How many times did the priest sprinkle the bull's blood before the veil of the sanctuary?
questions.explanation: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before Yahweh, before the veil of the sanctuary.

questions.text: Where did the priest pour out the rest of the blood of his bull?
questions.explanation: He put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense, and poured out the rest at the base of the altar of burnt offering.

answers.text: On the mercy seat behind the veil
On the ground outside the camp, far from the tents
At the base of the altar of burnt offering

questions.text: Where was the rest of the bull - its skin, meat, head, legs, innards and dung - burned?
questions.explanation: He carried all the rest of the bull outside of the camp to a clean place where the ashes are poured out, and burned it on wood with fire.

answers.text: On the altar of burnt offering
Outside the camp, where the ashes are poured out
In the court of the Tent of Meeting
In the camp, at the door of the priest's own tent

questions.text: Who laid their hands on the head of the bull when the whole congregation had sinned?
questions.explanation: The elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before Yahweh.

answers.text: Every man in the whole assembly of Israel

questions.text: What was a ruler who had sinned to bring as his offering?
questions.explanation: He shall bring as his offering a goat, a male without defect.

questions.text: Where was the ruler's goat to be killed?
questions.explanation: He shall lay his hand on the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before Yahweh.

answers.text: Outside the camp, beyond the tents
Inside the Tent of Meeting, before the veil
In the place where they kill the burnt offering
At the gate of the city

questions.text: Where did the priest put some of the blood of the ruler's sin offering?
questions.explanation: The priest shall take some of the blood with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering.

answers.text: On the horns of the altar of burnt offering
On the mercy seat inside the tent
On the doorposts of the ruler's own tent
On the ruler's head and hands

questions.text: What could one of the common people bring for his offering if he sinned unwittingly?
questions.explanation: If his sin is made known to him, he shall bring for his offering a goat, a female without defect.
